```yaml
name: Update ingestr

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'   # Run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:      # Allow manual trigger

concurrency:
  group: update-ingestr
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-ingestr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Check for ingestr update
        id: check
        run: |
          new_version=$(go list -m -u all | grep github.com/bruin-data/ingestr | awk '{print $3}')
          if [ -z "$new_version" ]; then
            echo "No update found"
            echo "new_version=" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "new_version=$new_version" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update ingestr
        if: steps.check.outputs.new_version != ''
        run: |
          go get github.com/bruin-data/ingestr@${{ steps.check.outputs.new_version }}
          go mod tidy

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check.outputs.new_version != ''
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump ingestr to ${{ steps.check.outputs.new_version }}"
          title: "chore: bump ingestr to ${{ steps.check.outputs.new_version }}"
          body: |
            Automated update of ingestr to ${{ steps.check.outputs.new_version }}.
          branch: "update-ingestr-${{ steps.check.outputs.new_version }}"
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
```
